sections.title: Childhood
sections.note: The three Spiritual Stones open the Door of Time.

items.name: Inside the Deku Tree
items.howTo: Get the Kokiri Sword from the Hole of "L" in the Forest Training Center and buy a Deku Shield at the Kokiri Shop, so Mido lets you past to the Great Deku Tree.
items.notes: Boss: Queen Gohma. Dungeon item: Fairy Slingshot. Master Quest rearranges the dungeon.

items.name: Meet Princess Zelda
items.howTo: Wake Talon with the Cucco from Malon's Weird Egg, push the crates into the moat to climb into the castle, then sneak past the guards to the courtyard.
items.notes: Impa teaches Zelda's Lullaby as she escorts you out.

items.name: Dodongo's Cavern
items.howTo: Show Zelda's Letter to the Kakariko guard to open the trail, play Saria's Song to Darunia for the Goron's Bracelet, then blow open the cavern with a Bomb Flower.
items.notes: Boss: King Dodongo. Dungeon item: Bomb Bag. Master Quest rearranges the dungeon.

items.name: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
items.howTo: Get Ruto's Letter from the bottle in Lake Hylia, show it to King Zora, and give Lord Jabu-Jabu a fish in a bottle.
items.notes: Boss: Barinade. Dungeon item: Boomerang. Master Quest rearranges the dungeon.

items.name: The Ocarina of Time
items.howTo: With all three Spiritual Stones, head to Hyrule Castle Town: Zelda flees with Impa and throws the Ocarina of Time into the castle moat.
items.reward: Ocarina of Time, Song of Time

items.name: The Master Sword
items.howTo: Place the three Spiritual Stones on the altar and play the Song of Time to open the Door of Time, then draw the Master Sword.
items.notes: Ganondorf follows you in and Link sleeps for seven years. Return the sword to the pedestal to become a child again.

sections.title: Seven Years Later
sections.note: The six Medallions awaken the Sages.

items.name: Chamber of Sages
items.howTo: Rauru gives it the first time you draw the Master Sword.

items.name: Forest Temple
items.howTo: Hookshot (from Dampé's race in Kakariko Graveyard) up to the entrance in Sacred Forest Meadow.
items.notes: Boss: Phantom Ganon. Dungeon item: Fairy Bow. Sage: Saria. Master Quest rearranges the dungeon.

items.name: Fire Temple
items.howTo: Wear the Goron Tunic (from Darunia's son or the Goron Shop) and enter Death Mountain Crater through Darunia's room in Goron City. Sheik teaches the Bolero of Fire at the crater's top entrance.
items.notes: Boss: Volvagia. Dungeon item: Megaton Hammer. Sage: Darunia. Master Quest rearranges the dungeon.

items.name: Ice Cavern
items.howTo: Walk across the ice floes of the frozen Zora's Fountain to the cave in the far corner.
items.notes: Mini-dungeon, no boss. Fill a bottle with Blue Fire here to thaw King Zora for the Zora Tunic.

items.name: Water Temple
items.howTo: Wear the Zora Tunic and the Iron Boots and sink to the entrance at the bottom of Lake Hylia.
items.notes: Boss: Morpha. Dungeon item: Longshot. Sage: Ruto. Master Quest rearranges the dungeon.

items.name: Bottom of the Well
items.howTo: As young Link, play the Song of Storms in the windmill to drain the well, then climb down into it.
items.notes: Mini-dungeon; young Link only. Dead Hand guards the Lens of Truth, which the Shadow Temple needs.

items.name: Shadow Temple
items.howTo: Warp in with the Nocturne of Shadow, then light the torches at the entrance with Din's Fire.
items.notes: Boss: Bongo Bongo. Dungeon item: Hover Boots. Sage: Impa. Sheik teaches the Nocturne of Shadow in Kakariko once you have the Forest, Fire and Water Medallions. Master Quest rearranges the dungeon.

items.name: Rescue the carpenters
items.howTo: Cross Gerudo Valley (Epona or the Longshot) and free the four carpenters from their cells, beating the Gerudo guard at each.
items.notes: The card opens the gate to the Haunted Wasteland and the Gerudo Training Ground.

items.name: Spirit Temple
items.howTo: Cross the Haunted Wasteland, then play the Requiem of Spirit (taught by Sheik at the Colossus) and do the temple as young Link and as an adult.
items.notes: Boss: Twinrova. Dungeon items: Silver Gauntlets (young Link's half) and Mirror Shield (adult half). Sage: Nabooru. Master Quest rearranges the dungeon.

items.name: Gerudo Training Ground
items.howTo: Pay 10 Rupees to the Gerudo at the gate (needs Gerudo's Card) and clear the rooms to reach the treasure at the centre.
items.notes: Optional mini-dungeon. Master Quest rearranges it.

items.name: Ganon's Castle
items.howTo: With all six Medallions the Sages build a rainbow bridge. Inside, clear the six trials (Forest, Water, Shadow, Fire, Light, Spirit) to dispel the barrier.
items.notes: Zelda gives you the Light Arrows in the Temple of Time once all six Sages are awake; they break the last barrier to the tower. The Golden Gauntlets are in a chest in the Shadow Trial.

items.name: Defeat Ganon
items.howTo: Climb Ganon's Tower, beat Ganondorf, escape the collapsing castle with Zelda, then defeat Ganon.
